full_prompt_en: A square impressionistic city painting shows a narrow rain-wet street in cool blue and violet, with shopfront lights reflected on the pavement. Tall stone facades frame the view, the left building rising close to the viewer and the right side partly veiled by leafy trees. Small dark windows and flower boxes break the left wall, while brown, teal, and warm orange doorways sit at street level. A slender lamppost stands near the left center, its yellow light echoed by a smaller lamp farther down the road. The street narrows toward a pale distant tower or roofline at the center, where a few tiny dark pedestrians appear amid blue haze. At the right, a low planted edge and slender trunks introduce green and yellow foliage over the darker facade. The foreground is almost entirely wet pavement. Broad horizontal strokes in turquoise, ultramarine, purple, and gray depict shallow puddles, while upright gold and white reflections stretch from lamps, windows, and bright distant sky. The building's cool blue shadow pushes against these vertical streaks of light. The perspective is street level and gently receding rather than perfectly measured; facades and foliage are broken into distinct dabs and short directional strokes. Light seems to come from a bright clearing at the far end of the street, with local amber lamps adding warmer notes nearer the viewer. Edges soften in the misty depth and sharpen around nearby doorways and darker wall lines. No signs are legible. The overall composition draws the eye along a luminous central corridor, balancing wet cool color, scattered warm light, and lively painterly marks in an otherwise quiet street.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形印象派城市绘画呈现一条狭窄的蓝紫色雨后街道，店面灯光映在湿亮路面。高石楼从两侧框住视线，左楼贴近观者而起，右侧部分被枝叶遮住。左墙上的小深窗和花箱打断立面，街面则有棕、青绿和暖橙色门口。细长路灯立在偏左中央，黄色灯光与街道深处较小的一盏相呼应。街道向中央远处淡色塔形屋顶收窄，几个微小深色行人出现在蓝色雾气中。右侧低矮种植边和细树干把绿色、黄色枝叶带到更暗的立面前。前景几乎全是湿路面。青绿、群青、紫和灰色宽阔横笔触描绘浅水洼，灯、窗和远处亮天的金白竖向倒影从中拉长。建筑的冷蓝影子与这些竖向光痕相推。视点处在街面，空间温和退远而非完全精确量测；立面和叶丛被拆成清楚的点彩与短方向笔触。光似乎来自街道尽端明亮的空隙，近处琥珀色路灯再加上暖色音符。边缘在有雾的深处变柔，在近处门口和较暗墙线周围较清楚。标牌均不可辨读。整体构图沿明亮的中央通道引导视线，以湿润冷色、散落暖光和活跃绘画痕迹平衡街道的安静。
style_prompt_en: Impressionistic painting uses broken, directional strokes to build a luminous surface from cool blues, violets, turquoise, and small amber-gold accents. Horizontal marks make reflective planes shimmer, while thin upright streaks carry the brightest light across them. Architecture and foliage resolve only enough to orient the viewer; their edges loosen into color fragments as distance increases. Broad blue shadow fields contain scattered warm points, so contrast guides the eye through the composition. Paint texture stays visible in short dabs, scumbled passages, and irregular layered color, never becoming a smooth digital gradient. Light is diffuse in the larger field, with concentrated local glows and a brighter distant opening. A central corridor of light organizes the view, while darker masses at the sides provide depth and enclosure. The overall effect is atmospheric and buoyant, making color reflections and brush rhythm more important than exact linear detail.
style_prompt_zh: 印象派绘画以断续而有方向性的笔触，用冷蓝、紫、青绿和少量琥珀金重音构成发亮表面。横向笔痕使反光平面闪动，细竖痕则把最亮的光带过其上。大形只解析到足以让观者辨识的程度；越远，边缘越松散成色彩碎片。宽阔蓝色阴影区包含散落暖点，以对比引导视线。短点、擦涂区域和不规则叠色保持颜料肌理可见，绝不变成平滑数字渐层。大范围光线漫射，局部光晕集中，远处开口更亮。中央光廊组织视野，两侧深色体块提供纵深和围合。整体效果有大气感而轻盈，让色彩倒影与笔触节奏比精确线条细节更重要。
theme_en: A rain-wet blue street with glowing shopfronts and distant figures
theme_zh: 蓝色雨后街道上，店面微光与远处人影相映
name: Laurent Parcelier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
